question: Eight years ago, the average age of A, B and C was 22 years. The average age of A and C after 2 years from now will be 32.5 years. What will be the age (in years) of B after 3 years from now?
solution:
Given:

Eight years ago, the average age of A, B, and C was 22 years. 

The average age of A and C after 2 years from now will be 32.5 years. 

Calculation:

Let the present age of A, B, and C be P, Q, and R years respectively.

According to the question,

[(P + 2) + (R + 2)]/2 = 32.5

⇒ P + 2 + R + 2 = 65

⇒ P + R = 65 - 4

⇒ P + R = 61 ....(1)

According to the question,

[(P - 8) + (Q - 8) + (R - 8)]/3 = 22

⇒ (P + Q + R) = 66 + 24

⇒ P + Q + R = 90 .....(2)

⇒ 61 + Q = 90 (From 1)

⇒ Q = 90 - 61

⇒ Q = 29

Now, the age of B after 3 years

⇒ 29 + 3 = 32 years

**∴ 32 years will be the age of B after 3 years from now.**
